note: Dates are inclusive, ISO format. Edit here; every script reads this file. Sprint ids are platform sprints S1-S5 (distinct from the earlier Sprint 1-4 history inside the trunk repo).

sprints.name: Foundations & Gates
sprints.goal: Adopt the trunk repo, move to PostgreSQL 18, and put CI, branch protection and the review workflow in place so every later feature ships through gates.
exit_criteria: docker compose boots PostgreSQL 18 and db.sql applies cleanly (CI db-integration green)
Five required checks (backend, db-integration, frontend, security, compose-smoke) enforced on main
pip-audit clean (starlette advisories closed) and the temporary waiver removed
import-linter: all contracts kept with no ignore
sprints.demo: Open a PR from a feature branch; show required checks, the PR template, and make pre-pr output.

sprints.name: Safe Dispatch
sprints.goal: Close the open dispatch gate and harden pre-flight so an approved recommendation provably reaches ARRIVED without ever sending an unsafe shipment.
exit_criteria: Approved allocation reaches ARRIVED under deterministic stepping; identical key+body replay verified
Executor coverage >= 90% with the permanent/transient/expired paths tested
Pre-flight property tests: no plan breaks any of the 9 rules, disrupted-route events, in-flight headroom
sprints.demo: Approve a recommendation, step the simulator, watch it arrive; replay the same request.

sprints.name: Resilience & Scenarios
sprints.goal: Prove behavior under change and failure: predictor fallback, the fault matrix, and the brief's crisis scenarios with do-nothing vs policy numbers.
exit_criteria: Predictor service with breaker + in-process fallback; FALLBACK banner visible and self-clearing
Every row of the resilience matrix has a test or recorded run and a visible degraded state
Acceptance suite covers delay, spike, depot constraint, route disruption, station outage, combined
sprints.demo: Kill the predictor, inject faults, watch banners and automatic recovery; show scenario results.

sprints.name: Scarcity, Deploy & Observe
sprints.goal: Add finite-supply rationing, deploy to Vercel/Render, ship dashboards and the load test; close security waivers; stretch only if ahead.
exit_criteria: Cover/rationing logic and isolation-risk flags live; acceptance shows fewer unmet liters than the plain heuristic
Deployed stack passes deploy-verify; rollback rehearsed once
k6 load test report with measured p50/p95/p99, throughput, error rate
Grafana dashboards provisioned; operator identity and token hardening merged
sprints.demo: Open the deployed app; show Grafana; show the k6 report.

sprints.name: Freeze, Evidence & Delivery
sprints.goal: Feature freeze at 18:00 on 25 Nov; evidence pack, demo rehearsal from a clean clone, tag v1.0.0, deliver on 26 Nov.
exit_criteria: Feature freeze observed (bug fixes only, 2 approvals)
Evidence pack complete: tests, load test, bake-off/scenario results, resilience demo notes
Cold start from a clean clone with docker compose up works; demo rehearsed
Tag v1.0.0 created; final report delivered
sprints.demo: The 14-step demonstration story from the brief.
